notes: Entry three: the attack, reconstructed. The horror entry, and the
first tape that describes what the player is standing in.
The order is the whole argument: **the ship went first.** Warp, then
impulse, then the long-range array -- three systems in the order you
would pick if you wanted a witness that could neither leave nor call,
and nobody aboard was hurt. She notices that and cannot explain it,
which is entry six's answer arriving two hundred days early.
"From the inside, with nothing on sensors" is the only clue planted
here, and it is planted without comment.
title: Personal Log -- Entry Three
subtitle: Lt. Lucy Shepard, cultural survey, U.S.S. Adirondack
author: recorded aboard this shuttle
extra: Day one hundred and forty-one. They came back.

lines.text: PERSONAL LOG -- ENTRY THREE
DAY 141 -- TWENTY-NINE JUNE
I have not recorded since March. There was nothing to say.
For four months this was the best posting in Starfleet.
Then this week. I am going to say it in order.
-- TWENTY-SEVEN JUNE --
I was at a market north of the county, beaming up.
Four people on the ground with a fever. Only four.
I logged it as seasonal. I wrote the word seasonal down.
-- TWENTY-EIGHT JUNE --
By morning the hospital had queues out of the doors.
By afternoon it had queues and no staff.
By dark the roads were the loudest thing on the continent.
I watched all of it from up here with a log running.
-- TWENTY-NINE JUNE --
Quiet. Not empty. Quiet is different, and it is worse.
Every plague I have studied takes weeks. This took two days.
Nothing moves that fast. Nothing natural. Record that.
-- ALSO --
In February somebody took our engines and our array.
Warp core, then impulse, then long range. In that order.
Nothing on sensors. The damage came from inside the hull.
Nobody up there was hurt. I never understood that part.
I understand it now. We were never the target.
We were the witnesses. They blinded us and went away.
Five months. They waited five months to be sure of us.
-- WHAT I CAN SEE --
It is this region. As far as I can scan, only this region.
One county, one river valley, a few towns past it.
If this is a test, it was given a boundary on purpose.
-- OUR PEOPLE --
Eleven of us stayed on the ground. For the work.
I have reached three of them. I am going to keep going.
If you are watching this: look for them. Some are alive.
Get them onto clear ground. The ship can still transport.
-- WHAT I KNEW --
I have eleven months of field notes on these people.
Names. Households. Who argues at the feed store.
A woman sold preserves, two stalls in from the road.
She asked me every week whether I was eating enough.
My notes have her as Subject Fourteen. In writing.
The recording stops. What follows is a new session.
Her name was Ruth. I am correcting the file.
-- ENTRY THREE ENDS --
